subject: Offline on the public site: Cloudflare answers /index.html with a redirect to /, and a cached redirect can't answer a navigation (the browser refuses it, so an offline visit would end on an error). The service worker now stores the shell as a plain copy of what the redirect gave, and keeps only real pages (200, not redirected) from navigations.
